champion.tips: DR. MUNDO TIPS AND TRICKS When ganking, get as close to the enemy as you can to make sure you land your Q . The further away, the easier it will before the enemy to dodge it and escape. Dr Mundo can do objectives pretty easily. Make sure you have priority in the mid and bot lane before starting the object so the enemy laners cannot contest. Your Ultimate R is a great trading tool. Don’t be afraid to fight the enemy alone if you find them on the map.
champion.builds: THE BEST DR. MUNDO BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Dr. Mundo Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Fleet Footwork as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Approach Velocity and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Heartsteel as your first item, followed by Boots of Swiftness and Dead Man's Plate. For your last 3 items, you should build Spirit Visage, Thornmail and finish with Overlord's Bloodmail. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 54.0% winrate over 18 997 matches played. Optional Your second option for Dr. Mundo Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Fleet Footwork as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Approach Velocity with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Warmog's Armor, which you should build first, followed by Boots of Swiftness as your second item and Heartsteel as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Spirit Visage, Thornmail and Randuin's Omen. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 48.9% win rate over 748 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, Demolish, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Approach Velocity with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Health Scaling, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Heartsteel as your first item, then Boots of Swiftness as a second item and Warmog's Armor as a third item. You want to finish the build with Spirit Visage, Thornmail and Unending Despair. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 52.0% win rate across 560 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Dr. Mundo Jungle build in the current patch, try Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, Fleet Footwork, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace as your primary rune tree, and Approach Velocity with Magical Footwear as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Health Scaling and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Titanic Hydra as your first item, then finish Boots of Swiftness as your second item, and Heartsteel as third item. The last 3 options are Overlord's Bloodmail, Spirit Visage and Randuin's Omen. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 48.7% win rate over 154 matches played. Situational Dr. Mundo Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Dr. Mundo build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Dr. Mundo runes page.
